sources.title: Scaling AI Safety for a Multi-Agent World - Schmidt Sciences
sources.snippet: Finally, the Cooperative AI Foundation's "Multi-Agent Risks from Advanced AI" report argues that interacting populations of AI agents introduce qualitatively new failure modes beyond single-agent systems, including collusion, conflict, destabilising dynamics, emergent agency, and novel multi-agent security vulnerabilities.

sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: Multi puts 300+ models from every major lab to work across four workflows, so you deploy the best AI for each task instead of forcing one to do it all. Using the right model for the right project is the advantage most people leave on the table.
